latHint: Think a spirit in a haunted house - not cool shadow.
pivHint: A SHADE is cool shadow on a sunny day - but in old poetry a SHADE is the what of a dead person?
winText: Boo. SHADE was the pivot - cool shadow to a GHOST.
lossText: GHOST - a spirit of the dead. SHADE was the pivot: cool SHADE to a SHADE of the dead.
